name: Stormbringer: Focal Point gives the group 5% crit on Call Lightning (#3079)
contract: Focal Point 706629 (Spell.dbc: passive Attributes 320, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA / aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 680876, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) promises "Casting $?s707615[Aeroblast][Call Lightning] now increases the critical strike chance of party and raid members by $680876s1% for $680876d". 680876 is Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with ApplyAuraName 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, EffectBasePoints 4 + EffectDieSides 1 = 5, EffectMiscValue 0 and an empty EffectSpellClassMask, EffectRadiusIndex 12 = 100 yd and DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, so it is a flat 5 percentage-point crit bonus for 10 s. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct calls Player::UpdateAllSpellCritChances and Player::UpdateSpellCritChance folds aura 290 into PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE, so the delta is exact and stat-independent. 706629's DBC ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips proc-entry generation and, with no spell_proc row, the aura has no entry in mSpellProcMap and the group buff is never cast. Call Lightning rank 13 (501399) carries SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10, the bit shared with Aeroblast; Arm of Thorim (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x2, no mana cost) is the negative control. The tooltip's "Does not stack with similar effects" clause has no spell_group backing and is deliberately not asserted here.
